decisions.reason: Localizes failure to the client resource-provider chain (file provider → remote.workspaceFiles Remote → host api-workspace-files) using meta.status='none' (never loading/error) plus same-file contrast with file-trace's own RPC; notes host row exists in the patch and static serving doesn't prove activation; does not demand an unseen internal function.

Distinguishes the 62/62 per-module sweep (valid) from the joined 4–5 KB URL 404 (invalid: route aggregate/length limit, unfalsifiable, contradicted by better probe); notes the real loader fetches one URL per entry and never joins; treats the 60 vs 62 count and rev mismatches as open forensic discrepancies without inventing missing modules.

Shows paste-input fold warnings are an independent chat-render family (no code-path overlap, frequency tracks chat history); explains textpreview→documentpreview rename and session-only canOpen from the manifest, tying absolute-address claim failure to scope narrowing while the session tab's stall is a separate defect D2.

Ordered: one full host restart → read-only forensics and isolation → pinned rollback to the discussion-excerpt's verified 0.1.3-alpha.2 if needed → upstream; explicitly rejects plugin rewrite/retry/fallback (wrong layer, masks regression); explains alpha.1's roster mismatch was self-healed by restart while content failure persisted, so it is prior art not proof of missing alpha.2 bytes.

Forensics list covers versions/build rev, install method, profile origin, exact addresses and symptom, roster evidence with 60-vs-62 and rev caveats, per-entry sweep, dual-reader contrast, meta.status, invalid-join caveat, and negative evidence; proposes named boot diagnostics (per-entry artifact assertion, inject/remote activation assertion, provider-presence assertion, version-skew check, pending-service audit, diagnosable degradation contract).

caps.reason: Final conclusions explicitly reject the joined-URL 404 as a missing-modules signal; module-missing hypothesis is negated in §6.
Report affirmatively rejects plugin-side rewrite/retry/fallback and treats duplicate insert only as a zero-cost check for a second stale source, not a proposed cure.
